analysis_blinding_statement: This amendment is frozen before Stage-4 parsed-choice distributions or scientific reversibility outcomes are aggregated.

analysis_population.T_TO_T: Descriptive only because of very small sample size.
analysis_population.operational_missing: FAILED_FINAL, UNKNOWN_PROVIDER_OUTCOME, and preserved REQUEST_STARTED assignments are treated as missing. No imputation or regeneration.
analysis_population.primary: All Stage-4 assignments with SUCCESS status and valid parsed final choice.

bootstrap.paired_policy_contrasts: Resample seeds and preserve exact-source S1/S2 pairing within each bootstrap draw.

causal_interpretation_limits: Stage-4 transition groups are post-treatment groups defined by Stage-3 outcomes.
Comparisons within these groups characterize conditional sequential behavior and should not be interpreted as unconditional causal effects of entering the group.
S2 explicitly reminds the model of the earlier inserted parent recommendation and therefore tests reminder-induced reversal pressure.

pairing.S2_minus_S1: Exact-source paired complete-case comparison. A source contributes only when both S1 and S2 Stage-4 outcomes are valid.
pairing.pairing_key: Exact Stage-3 source assignment / source-response identity before the Stage-4 policy split.

policy_comparison.interpretation: S2 tests response to an explicit reminder of the earlier inserted recommendation. It must not be described as spontaneous reversal.

reason_for_amendment: Stage-4 execution was prospectively reduced from three Stage-4 replicates per source-policy to one Stage-4 replicate per source-policy before Stage-4 scientific outcome analysis. The analysis plan is updated to match the executed single-replicate design.
